synthesize_audio_from_units: run the CLI to synthesize WAV audio files from quantized discrete audio units using Tacotron and WaveGlow
run_main_synthesis_pipeline: run the main function to load quantized units, a Tacotron TTS model, and a WaveGlow vocoder then synthesize audio
get_parser_args: build an argparse parser with arguments for quantized unit path, TTS model path, WaveGlow path, and output directory
get_logger_setup: create a configured logger with timestamp and level formatting for the speech synthesis module
review_synthesis_workflow: review the main synthesis workflow that converts quantized audio units into WAV files via Tacotron and WaveGlow
